replies.text: {"verdicts":[{"id":"T1","keep":true,"reason":"Design states link-only access with no login; enumeration of share namespace is concrete attack."},{"id":"T2","keep":true,"reason":"Design explicitly says links never expire; leaked-link permanent access is distinct from enumeration."},{"id":"T3","keep":true,"reason":"Design names S3 bucket storage; direct bucket exposure bypassing app is a distinct attack path."},{"id":"T4","keep":true,"reason":"Unauthenticated download path and S3 egress named; cost/DoS amplification is concrete."},{"id":"T5","keep":true,"reason":"Design has user uploads served to viewers; stored XSS via HTML/SVG on share origin is concrete."},{"id":"T6","keep":true,"reason":"Anonymous viewing named in design; missing access records for leaked-document investigation is specific."},{"id":"T7","keep":true,"reason":"Caching/indexing of the login-free documents the design serves is specific, distinct from guessing links."},{"id":"T8","keep":true,"reason":"Upload plus never-expiring public link enables malware/phishing hosting; distinct harm from XSS on viewers."}]}
